subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Which media-boundary fix should own trusted `read` image results that contain image blocks but no `details.path` before Feishu outbound delivery?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the open candidates differ on whether to trust original local path args or persist image bytes into an inbound media reference, and that choice affects local-media exposure behavior.

options.title: Use media-store promotion
options.body: Repair or land the `media://inbound/...` approach so pathless image bytes become a bounded media reference before channel delivery.

options.title: Use local-arg fallback
options.body: Allow `path` or `file_path` fallback only if maintainers explicitly accept the local-path trust boundary and preserve root checks and safe failure text.

options.title: Hold for live proof
options.body: Keep both PRs paused until one supplies current-head Feishu proof and addresses the related local-reference exposure concern.

recommendation.title: Use media-store promotion
recommendation.body: Repair or land the `media://inbound/...` approach so pathless image bytes become a bounded media reference before channel delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The current active extractor and pending media merge surfaces blame to recent work by vincentkoc, and the choice crosses shared agent media plus Feishu delivery behavior.
